A pure-white fawn steps delicately onto the cobbled path between the cottages, unafraid.
A slow fall of cherry-blossom petals drifts across the little arched bridges, catching the warm light.
A soft swirl of glowing pixies and fireflies winds up around a turret like living light.
A flight of white swans glides along the quiet stream, leaving silver trails behind them.
A pure-white unicorn stands at the village edge, still and gentle in the early mist.
A procession of soft fae-lights floats in a winding line along the mossy garden path.
A great low moon rises tender and full behind the rooftops, filling the village with gold.
A small white rabbit sits calm and still on a cottage doorstep, watching the lane.
A tiny lantern boat drifts slowly along the stream, its warm glow reflected in the water.
A cloud of pale glow-moths rises softly from the meadow, drifting over the garden walls.
A delicate rainbow arches through the silver mist above the oldest bridge and the willows.
A white owl glides silently between two cottages, its wings brushing the lantern-lit air.
A red fox pauses on a worn doorstep, its ears tilted, listening to the night softly.
Cherry-blossom petals spiral down over the little stone bridge in a slow, unhurried pink shower.
Fireflies gather in a gentle, breathing cluster around the ivy-covered turret, pulsing with soft amber.
A second flight of white swans curves low over the rooftops, turning toward the quiet stream.
Fae-lights drift one by one down the winding path like a slow, patient river of warmth.
The white unicorn bows its head gently over the stream, its reflection trembling in the current.
A white fawn and a small rabbit rest together near the garden gate, unhurried and calm.
Glow-moths rise in a soft, luminous column above the oldest cottage, turning lazily in the air.
The low moon casts long pale shadows across the cobblestones and the sleeping window-box flowers.
A white owl lands briefly on a mossy roof-ridge, folding its wings with quiet ceremony.
A tiny lantern boat catches the current and passes under the bridge into the gentle dark.
A rainbow bends softly through the morning mist, resting one end on the village green.
The white fawn lifts its head, ears wide, then steps quietly back into the blossom-lined lane.
